description: Somebody flattened a acre of hardpan with a blade and called it a freight yard. A shipping container on blocks serves as the office, its door wedged open with a fuel can; a hand-lettered board by the step lists what needs moving and what it pays, in a hand that presses hard enough to tear the paper. Two trailers sit on their legs with the grass grown up through the axles. Everything here has crossed the waste at least once and looks it.
name: The Last Load
